milestones.title: SFP insert-event soak (MGMT_INIT debounce + cancel-on-remove)
milestones.goal: Translate the SFP insert-event soak so a new insert (port_dict value '1') is withheld from processing for MGMT_INIT_TIME_DELAY_SECS (2s) and re-injected only once the delay elapses, while a remove ('0') arriving during the window cancels the pending insert.
